args.summary: checkout-api deployment v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production (error rate ~18%) across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled the service back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. Rollback verified. Please investigate the v2.3.1 failure to identify root cause before attempting re-release.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an ~18% error rate. Checking deployment history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back:** Rolled out v2.3.0 to all production regions — verified as rolled out in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2):** The on-call engineer has been paged. The incident describes the v2.3.1 health check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and requests a root-cause investigation before any re-release of v2.3.1.
